=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:506-557 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_instruction_paths` accepts absolute or invalid paths such as `/tmp/consumer/src/app.py`, but `classify_validation_paths` drops them instead of counting them as project-owned, so `project_paths` stays empty.
  WHY: A mixed verdict is routed as harness-only (`reason="backstop"`) and the consumer fix-up is suppressed. Severity is MAJOR for all four reviewers.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:169,506-510 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `HARNESS_BARE_FILE_RE` and `_instruction_paths` drop extensionless files such as `Makefile`, `Dockerfile` and `LICENSE` before the ownership classifier sees them.
  WHY: A harness-owned file named under `target_repo=consumer` gets a consumer fix-up instead of a heal report. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus say NIT, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and openai_gpt-6-luna say MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:535-546 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When `load_validation_managed_paths` raises `ValueError`, `_harness_route` continues the backstop with an empty `managed = frozenset()`, which contradicts the helper's documented fallback.
  WHY: The classification is built from partial data and can misroute. Skipping the backstop and letting only the verdict field decide would fix it.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:586-588 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `_harness_ops` comment says "A workflow-failure heal report was sent", but the `heal_report` op is only queued and P3b is not implemented.
  WHY: The comment is misleading. In the current state nothing is sent and the item stays blocked.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:572-575 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_report_op` emits report kind `pull_request` for PR items, but `REPORT_IDENTITY_WORKFLOW_BY_KIND["pull_request"]` (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py` ~422-425) lists only `workflow_failure_heal.yml`, not `unblock_judge.yml`.
  WHY: OIDC-attested PR reports fail the identity check with `job_workflow_ref_mismatch` once P3b sends them. Severity disagreement: two reviewers say NIT, openai_gpt-6-luna says MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:852-856 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The protected-rejection early return in `plan` runs before `_harness_route`, so a `target_repo=harness` verdict with a `descope` or `operator_step` protected rejection never emits the harness `heal_report` or `hold_request` ops.
  WHY: The item takes `_protected_handoff_ops` (operator step, comment, warning) and the harness issue gets no heal report.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Use Refs #N only."
  expected_change_site: PR description
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description includes "Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/7949" rather than using only a `Refs` reference.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:548-557 (`_harness_route`, calling `ownership.classify_validation_paths` in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py` lines 1534-1537) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_instruction_paths` accepts absolute paths such as `/tmp/consumer/src/app.py` and `../x/y.py`, and `classify_validation_paths` drops them, so `project_paths` stays empty.
  WHY: A mixed verdict is routed as harness-only (`reason="backstop"`) and the consumer fix-up is suppressed. The fix belongs in `_harness_route`, which should count every token that fails `ownership._normalize_validation_path` as project-owned.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:169,509 (`HARNESS_BARE_FILE_RE`, `_instruction_paths`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Extensionless root files such as `Makefile` and `Dockerfile` are dropped before the ownership classifier sees them.
  WHY: A consumer fix-up is filed for a harness-owned file. A small allowlist of known extensionless names would cover it.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:542-546 (`_harness_route`, `except ValueError`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed managed-path lookup continues the backstop with an empty managed set, which contradicts the helper's docstring.
  WHY: Every synced wrapper looks consumer-owned, so the classification comes from partial data. Skipping the backstop would match the documented contract.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:586-588 (`_harness_ops`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The comment "A workflow-failure heal report was sent" is false, because `unblock_run_ops` has no case for `heal_report` or `hold_request` and no P3b implementation exists in this PR.
  WHY: Until P3b lands, nothing is sent and the item stays blocked. "is being sent" would be accurate.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py (`_heal_report_op`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: PR items emit report kind `pull_request`, and `REPORT_IDENTITY_WORKFLOW_BY_KIND["pull_request"]` (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py` line 424) lists only `workflow_failure_heal.yml`.
  WHY: P3b must extend the `pull_request` entry too, or OIDC-attested reports for blocked PRs fail the identity check. This is a handoff note, not a defect in this diff.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:169 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `HARNESS_BARE_FILE_RE` excludes extensionless files such as `Makefile`.
  WHY: A `Makefile` that exists only in SUPPORT_DIR, named under `target_repo=consumer`, is rejected by the backstop and routed to the consumer fix-up instead of the harness.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:548-553,557 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `classify_validation_paths` drops paths that do not match the ownership rules instead of treating them as project-owned.
  WHY: With `validation/x.sh` plus a skipped absolute consumer path, no project paths are returned, and the consumer fix-up is suppressed with the verdict routed to the harness.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:535-538 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The handler for `ownership.load_validation_managed_paths` catches `ValueError` but proceeds with `frozenset()`.
  WHY: This deviates from the expected behavior. It should log a warning and proceed correctly.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:574 (`_heal_report_op`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py` lists only `workflow_failure_heal.yml` for the kinds referenced by `_heal_report_op`.
  WHY: OIDC-attested reports for blocked PRs may fail the identity check if the `pull_request` kind is not supported.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:586-588 (`_harness_ops`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The comment says the heal report "was sent", but the op is only queued and executed later.
  WHY: It is misleading and should say "is being sent".
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_actions.py `_harness_route`, `except ValueError` around `ownership.load_validation_managed_paths`. Skip the backstop with `harness_paths=[]` and `project_paths=[]` so only the field decides. About 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:506-510 (`_instruction_paths`); 169 (`HARNESS_BARE_FILE_RE`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The backstop filters out extensionless filenames such as `Makefile`. A root `Makefile` fails the bare-file regex, and `scripts/Makefile` fails because `scripts/` is not an allowed prefix and the name has no matching extension.
  WHY: A harness-owned `Makefile` change labelled `target_repo=consumer` gets consumer routing, so the fix-up is filed in the wrong repository instead of generating a heal report.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:548-557 (`_harness_route`); scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1534-1538 (`classify_validation_paths`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The routing decision treats an empty `project_paths` as proof that no project-owned path was named, but the classifier skips invalid paths. `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:8450` confirms `../x` is omitted.
  WHY: With `/tmp/consumer/src/app.py` alongside `validation/x.sh`, only the harness path is returned and the consumer fix-up is suppressed as harness-only.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:852-856 (`plan`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The protected-rejection early return runs before `_harness_route`, so a `target_repo=harness` verdict never emits the harness `heal_report` or project `hold_request` ops for `descope` or `operator_step` with a `protected_rejection`.
  WHY: The item takes `_protected_handoff_ops` instead, which gives an operator step, comment and warning, and the harness issue gets no heal report.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:572-575 (`_heal_report_op`); scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:422-425 and 2555-2560 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: PR items produce a `pull_request` heal-report kind, but the identity allowlist for that kind includes only `workflow_failure_heal.yml`, not `unblock_judge.yml`.
  WHY: When the P3b sender attaches an OIDC identity from `unblock_judge.yml`, `verify_report_identity` rejects the PR report with `job_workflow_ref_mismatch`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Use Refs #N only." | Expected change site: PR description | Evidence of absence: The PR description includes "Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/7949" rather than using only a `Refs` reference. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:506-508,538-557 (`_instruction_paths`, `_harness_route`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_instruction_paths` accepts absolute paths, but `classify_validation_paths` drops them (`is_valid_repo_path` rejects them at `workflow_failure_heal.py:1885`, and the classifier does `continue` at line 1536).
  WHY: With "Fix validation/x.sh and /tmp/consumer/src/app.py", the backstop sees `harness_paths=["validation/x.sh"]` and `project_paths=[]`, routes to harness, and sends a heal report instead of the consumer fix-up.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:169,509 (`HARNESS_BARE_FILE_RE`, `_instruction_paths`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The backstop drops extensionless filenames such as `Makefile`, `Dockerfile` and `LICENSE`, because the regex requires a dot and an extension.
  WHY: "Edit scripts/Makefile" with `target_repo=consumer` is dropped before the classifier and defaults to consumer mode. The reviewer calls this narrow, since the `target_repo` field handles most cases.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
